messages:
maria: kicking off int4 onboarding smoke for ceres13b (13B). quant scheme: groupwise 64, per-group scale+zero, no outlier folding. running summarization + long-context regen evals.
cheng: cool — any immediate deltas vs fp16 baseline?
olivia: ping for logs + repro so we can triage quickly :eyes:
maria: quick readouts: rouge drop ~3 on cnn_dailymail vs fp16, and for longcontext (>2048) some hallucination & repeated phrases. also kv-cache misalignment after ~2100 tokens — output tokens become garbled.
maria: command I ran:
```bash
runtest --model ceres13b --quant int4 --group 64 --batch 1 --max-tokens 4096 --evalsets cnn,longctx-regress
```
log snippet:
```
[run] loading quant tables... ok
[run] step 2048: kv-copy OK
[run] step 2104: KV: token id mismatch detected (expected 0x7e, got 0x3f)
[run] generating: "The study found that… The study found that…"
```
benchmark-bot: perf: p95=180ms batch=1 (A40, int4), tokens/s=210, mem=26GB
cheng: kv misalign + repeated pattern smells like rotary/head packing issue — ceres checkpoint uses split-head layout (heads interleaved in groups of 2). did convert_weights honor head ordering?
maria: we used convert_weights --reorder=head-interleave (default script). trying preserve-head-order now to see.
olivia: also double-check tokenizer mapping. I spotted an extra BOS->0 in their vocab that could shift token ids in some exporters; that manifests as pad-like repeats in long outputs.
maria: quick weight dump shows proj matrix axes look transposed in quantized dump vs fp16 dump. sizes match but rows vs cols interpretation might be swapped for some linear layers (proj: (3072,12288)).
cheng: can you run a deterministic compare of first 100 tokens for same prompt? use --seed and --no-sampling to isolate model differences: `compare-llm-outputs --ref fp16 --cand int4 --prompt-file smoke_prompts.txt --seed 42 --max-tokens 100`
maria: pasted first divergent region (fp16 vs int4):
```
fp16: "In conclusion, the patients experienced a 12% improvement..."
int4: "In conclusion, the patients experienced a \u0000\u0000 improvement..."
```
cheng: that NUL-like token often indicates a casting/pack endianness problem in the quantized cache. hypothesis: rotary parameters got transposed per-head leading to sign flips in half the head dims. try convert with `--transpose-rotary` or `--swap-head-endian` to validate.
olivia: i'll run headwise rotary sanity across 96 heads and compare phase polynomials. will report in ~15m.
dev-bot: job/1754444444-rotary-sanity: completed — head mismatch detected on heads [3,7,15,22] sign-flip in odd heads (phase sign inversion).
cheng: ok that matches an endianness/headpack bug. quick fix is to add `--transpose-rotary` to convert and add unit test asserting headwise cosine/sine continuity across head indices.
maria: reran quant conversion with --transpose-rotary + preserve-head-order. longcontext now stable up to 8k tokens, rouge recovered +2 (still ~1 point behind fp16). hallucination regressions gone. marking remaining 1pt gap as follow-up to check attention-proj axis packing in quantizer.
olivia: I'll open PR with the conversion flag + a reproducer test and add tokenizer sanity check to ingestion script. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
maria: marking this thread — follow-up: QUANT-874 inspect proj-axis-packing and add forced dtype-cast step.
summary: smoke onboarding for ceres13b int4 found rotary/head packing endianness causing kv misalignments; fixed by transpose-rotary during convert; follow-ups on proj packing and tokenizer mapping
